card.name: Inside split drug and foreign words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of long words that are split up, such as drug names, Lao script, Malay words and error codes. It fires on the middle piece, not the start or the end.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a longer drug or brand name.
modes.example: so<<fos>>buvir individually may occur with led

modes.label: Lao and Malay text
modes.description: A piece within Lao script or a Malay word.
modes.example: untuk tatapan kita semua. Malaysia merangkumi Indonesia, Semenanjung, Borneo dan Filipina Dalam tulis<<annya>> Rev John Russell menyifatkan sel

modes.label: Error codes and names
modes.description: A piece inside an all-caps error code or a place name.
modes.example: indicate the error. ERRORS EACCES Search permission denied for directory in file's path prefix. EEXIST Unable to generate a unique filename. E<<INTR>> The call was interrupted by a signal.

card.plain: It fires partway through long or unusual words, mostly drug names and non-English text, where the word is not finished yet.
